name: Dam Battlegrounds
description: A massive hydroelectric dam overrun by ARC forces. Dense combat zones around the spillways and generator rooms.

name: Buried City
description: The ruins of a once-thriving metropolis, now half-buried beneath sand and rubble. Rich in loot but dangerous.

name: The Spaceport
description: An abandoned launch facility with hangars, control towers, and scattered ARC tech. Wide open sightlines.

name: Blue Gate
description: A fortified checkpoint between regions. Tight corridors and verticality make for intense firefights.

name: Stella Montis
description: A mountainous region with alpine forests and hidden bunkers. High-value resources scattered across the peaks.
